ability_iss.configuration.replaceTensura: Replace Tensura's ability charging HUD with ISS's overlays when ability-tensura is loaded; applies live in both directions. Default: true.
ability_iss.configuration.tensuraAbiliti: OverlayHandler element id of Tensura's abilities layer (0 status, 1 status bars, 2 abilities, 3 analysis). Default: 2.
ability_iss.configuration.disableTensura: Switch Tensura's abilities layer element off as well as its own config flag (belt-and-braces). Default: true.
ability_iss.configuration.menu.tooltip: Display of the Spells tab in the ability menu.
ability_iss.configuration.tab.tooltip: Which spells list in the Spells tab, and how rows read.
ability_iss.configuration.spellbook.tool: Server ceiling on the spellbook bar's cells.
ability_iss.configuration.held.tooltip: What counts as holding a spell for listing and greying.
ability_iss.configuration.icon.tooltip: The Spells tab's icon as an item id (empty = no icon). Default: the Divine Pearl.
ability_iss.configuration.sprite.tooltip: The Spells tab's menu sprite as a texture path (empty = a text-only label). Default: none.
ability_iss.configuration.schoolChipText: Texture template for the school filter chips, %s replaced by the school path (empty = no chip icons). Default: each school's scroll.
ability_iss.configuration.schoolOrder.to: Order of the school filter strip as type:<school> entries (empty = ISS's registry order).
ability_iss.configuration.showCooldownSw: Draw the cooldown readiness sweep on spellbook cells. Default: on.
Hide the spellbook bar when the equipped book has no castable spells (off = it always shows). Default: on.
List every registered spell in the Spells tab (off = only spells the player has encountered, or is holding). Default: off.
ability_iss.configuration.greyUnheldRows: Grey a Spells-tab row whose spell is not being held right now (off = rows never grey for holding). Default: on.
ability_iss.configuration.maxCells.toolt: Highest number of cells the spellbook bar may show (server ceiling; the book's own capacity clamps below it). Default: 18.
Curios slots count as holding a spell. Default: on.
ability_iss.configuration.includeArmor.t: Armor slots count as holding a spell (the offhand always does). Default: on.
